Name

paragraph-subs - preserve substitutions in styled paragraphs

Synopsis

S01 code;; bold expanded link (1)
S02 next:: italic <!--(2)-->
  1. Enabled substitutions in the source paragraph.
  2. Formatted continuation.
S03 literal;; <1>
S04 literal:: \<2>
S05 listing;; {value} *literal* <1>
S06 inactive:: footnote:unused[No note.] indexterm2:[No entry] (1)
  1. Default substitutions do not register these macros.
S07 active:: [1] (1)
  1. The note is registered exactly once.
S08 verse;; {value} *literal*

Reuse [1].

  1. One note. ↩
